name: QATAR PRESS
note: QPress is a Doha-based B2B printing-services company (offset/digital printing, packaging) serving business and government clients, with no shopping cart or consumer storefront. Correctly excluded (B2B services, no digital retail channel).

name: Andorra Village
note: A luxury residential compound/real-estate development in North Riyadh renting villas and apartments via a 'Book Now' inquiry form, not a product retailer. Correctly excluded (real estate).

name: DAR AL RAYYAN TRDG & CONT WLL - DOHA, QATAR
note: Name indicates a Qatari trading and contracting (WLL) firm with wholesale NAICS codes (paper/office-supply wholesale) and no domain on file; no consumer retail arm is discoverable. Correctly excluded (B2B trading/contracting, unverifiable per Gate 7).

name: Alshawaf Group
note: Riyadh conglomerate of 12 mostly hard-excluded divisions (building materials, heavy machinery, steel, real estate, construction FF&E) alongside a bookstore/stationery arm; mixed conglomerate so the parent is excluded per Gate 6. Its 'Shawaf Store' stationery subsidiary (shawafstore.com) could merit its own separate row.

name: MIQYASS FOR TECHNICAL CONSULTING.
note: A Saudi/GCC B2B technical-consulting and conformity-assessment firm (testing, inspection, certification, SASO/SFDA/GSO compliance), not a retailer. Correctly excluded (B2B services).

name: Jamal Baghlaf Holding Group (JBHG)
note: A Riyadh diversified holding/investment company spanning real estate & contracting, food manufacturing (dates/poultry/aquaculture), and tech/VC, with no consumer retail or e-commerce. Correctly excluded (holding, Gate 6).

name: IIPH - International Islamic Publishing House
note: Saudi-HQ'd (Riyadh, +966) publisher that also runs a genuine consumer D2C online bookstore: hundreds of titles across many categories in 15+ languages, working cart/checkout, PayPal, shipping. Books are an approved category and the consumer e-commerce arm qualifies it under the corrected Gate 2; the name-pattern exclusion was wrong.

name: AlFursan Holding | الفرسان القابضة
note: A holding company whose domain does not resolve (DNS failure) with no identifiable consumer-retail subsidiary. Correctly excluded (holding per Gate 6; unverifiable per Gate 7).

name: Takween Bookstore & Publishing House
note: A live Kuwait-based consumer bookstore and publisher with a full e-commerce store (cart/checkout, user accounts, wishlists, promotions), ~150+ books across 40+ categories plus branded merchandise. Books/stationery is an approved category; the name-pattern auto-exclusion was wrong.

name: Sand Brush
note: 'Surf Brush' is a San Clemente, California company selling essentially one product (a sand-removal brush in two sizes/three colors). Fails geography (not Gulf) and scale (single narrow product line). Correctly excluded.

name: Toy Triangle LLC.
note: A Jeddah toy distributor/wholesaler representing 65+ brands that sells through third-party marketplaces (Amazon.sa, Noon) and authorized retailers (its store-locator points to Toys R Us, City Toys, etc.), with no own consumer checkout. A pure distributor with no dedicated retail arm, so it fails even under the corrected Gate 2.

name: مستر مندوب | Mr Mandoob
note: A multi-service delivery/courier aggregator (parcel, grocery/pharmacy delivery from other stores, gas, digital recharge) which is the hard-excluded marketplace/aggregator pattern; prior review found app installs far below the 50k rescue threshold. Site bot-blocked re-fetch and search budget was exhausted, so the download figure could not be independently re-confirmed, but the aggregator model itself is disqualifying.

name: BLOCKAT - بلوكات
note: Confirmed via its LinkedIn as an online Kids & Family retail e-commerce platform (an approved category), but blockatapp.com now redirects to a GoDaddy parked/for-sale page and no live storefront or 50k+ app could be confirmed (search budget exhausted). Genuinely unresolved.

name: Bahamdoon Trading Company
note: A live Saudi B2C online store built on Salla selling office furniture, stationery, paper and computer supplies, with real customer reviews/transactions (Riyadh buyer confirmed), KSA-wide shipping and physical branches. Approved categories (stationery/furniture/electronics) and a genuine consumer storefront; the 'Trading Company' name-pattern exclusion doesn't hold (office-supplies orientation noted).

name: AlJraiwy Furniture
note: Furniture is an approved category, but the listed domain does not resolve (DNS failure) and the rulebook's required moved-domain/app rescue search could not be run (search budget exhausted). Genuinely unresolved rather than a confirmed dead account.

name: Alharfash Group
note: The domain actually resolves and returns HTTP 503 (a live server, not the original 'http_code=000/no site' call), but no content could be read and no search could be run to determine the business model. Original dead-site reason is questionable and the account is genuinely unresolved.

name: AL-ASFOUR FURNITURE Co. Ltd.
note: Saudi (Eastern Province, est. 1968) furniture company with a manufacturing plant PLUS three multi-floor consumer showrooms (Safwa 3,500sqm, Khobar 2,500sqm, Dammam) selling home furniture, curtains, carpets and home accessories to residential customers, and a first-pass scan found cart/checkout signals. Textbook Lazurde pattern (manufacturer + substantial dedicated consumer retail); the exclusion rested only on the corrected-away 'manufacturing/B2B disqualifies' reading. Storefront bot-blocked direct re-fetch.

name: Al Nisr Al Arabi for Export & Import and Commissionable Agent Company
note: The company's own name is dispositive: an export/import and commission-agent (brand-agency) business, i.e. the Alireza pattern with no consumer retail of its own. Site returned 503, but the name confirms a B2B import/export model. Correctly excluded.

name: almalki
note: Al Malki Group is a 65-year-old Jeddah B2B brand-distributor/development partner representing ~100 fragrance/cosmetics/watch/fashion brands for commercial partners, with no dedicated consumer retail storefront (Alireza pattern). Correctly excluded (B2B distribution).

name: AL Nasaem Cosmetics Company LLC
note: A Kuwait cosmetics/beauty retailer with a live e-commerce store (cart/checkout, loyalty program) and a physical location at Luxury Mall Salmiya, spanning makeup, skincare, haircare, perfume and beauty tools (large SKU count). Cosmetics is an approved category; the 'building_materials' keyword tag was a clear misclassification.

name: ALshaya Group
note: M.H. Alshaya is a Kuwait-HQ'd retail franchise operator with 3,000+ stores and 70+ brands (H&M, Mothercare, Starbucks, etc.) across fashion, footwear, F&B, beauty, pharmacy, optics and home, plus a growing online business. The 'DEAD http_code=000' was a bot-block (site is live); every division is retail-qualifying so it passes as a consolidated account per Gate 6, consistent with the rulebook already treating Alshaya as a covered group.

name: Alomary office furniture company
note: A Saudi office-furniture manufacturer and retailer with a real B2C e-commerce store (cart, wishlist, accounts), showrooms and 10+ categories, so the 'building_materials' keyword reason is wrong, but the business is heavily B2B/institutional office-outfitting oriented and office furniture is a low-repeat category. Genuinely ambiguous whether the consumer arm qualifies.

name: ALMOTHALATH
note: Independently cross-verified as 'Triangle Trading Company,' a B2B institutional supplier of furniture and educational equipment to nurseries, kindergartens and schools; its customer base is institutional, not consumer. Site bot-blocked re-fetch, but the specific institutional-supplier finding stands. Correctly excluded.

name: Alfardan Group
note: A Qatari mixed conglomerate (jewellery, automotive/BMW, real estate, hospitality, marine, exchange, medical, agriculture); the corporate site has no consumer storefront. Mixed conglomerate so the parent is excluded per Gate 6 (the retail-qualifying Alfardan Jewellery would need its own row). The 'building_materials' reason was wrong, but the exclusion outcome is correct.
